answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the comet solution is checked at the ferrous gate and logged, the ridge audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 24 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. The deposit is 64 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
